reference: AA24-109A reports Akira threat actors using Rclone, with advisory mappings T1048; AA25-071A reports Medusa actors using Rclone, with advisory mappings T1567.002. These mappings describe the cited reports and do not establish that every use of the software has these behaviors. The Akira report cites T1048 (Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol); the Medusa report cites T1567.002 (Exfiltration to Cloud Storage). These are distinct source-reported mappings for the same software.
